newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian stocks mixed to lower on OTC market.
newsitem.headline: Croatian stocks mixed to lower on OTC market.

text.p: Following is the closing report for Croatia's over-the-counter market in Varazdin for Thursday, October 17.
* Two of nine active stocks rose, two fell and five were flat.
* Volume lower at 1,200 units, turnover also down 95,932 German marks.
* Top gainer was shipper Jadroplov, up 16.67 percent to 70 marks on volume of 50 shares.
* Confectioner Kras was the bigger of the two decliners, falling 4.52 percent to 190 marks with 29 shares sold.
* Electronic firm Ericsson Tesla was the most active issue, trading flat at 50 marks on volume of 585 shares.
